## pary-p07-v40 — C1

**SUMMARY.** All being will-led rested-rested in supreme Bhairava, then emitted. Within-hidden boundless-mirrored supreme knowing speaks pure publishing once-flooded. Three-coursed time self-drawn outside, self-drawn within: time-drawer glorious. Split inward-whole beholding high-low; seeing agency standing on Lord. Middle sequenced gross inwardly fancied undivided; breath-work split. Self-impressed past-two-states; measured Māyā may-see; sequence subtle. Two-states entered sequenced, thoughts stilled; blessed expanse wonder-seen.

*Rasa: śānta of rested-emitted; vīra of pure publishing; adbhuta of self-drawn time; adbhuta of standing beholding; vīra of split-unified; vīra of subtle measure; adbhuta of wonder-seen expanse — The sthāyibhāva is peace: rested, rested, emitted. Resting relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: hidden, mirrored, published pure. Publishing relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: triple-coursed, self-drawn. Drawing relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: split, whole, beheld, standing. Beholding relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: sequenced, fancied undivided, split. Splitting relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: stamped, measured, subtle. Measuring relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: entered, stilled, wonder-seen. Perceiving relished.*
